rationale: The proposed topology enhances the LNA's noise performance and gain by incorporating a common-gate (CG) input stage in series with the existing common-source (CS) stage, forming a cascode-like structure with improved input matching and reduced noise figure. The addition of an inductor in the source path of the input NMOS provides resonant tuning at 1.575 GHz, boosting gain and improving S11 by enhancing input impedance matching. This edit directly targets the most negative margin (nf_db) while maintaining stability and improving S21 and S11, which are also below specification. The topology remains within the device budget, uses only one inductor (within limit), and avoids floating nodes.
